output_list.criticism: Integer overflow in generateTokens function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, aka 'tradeTrap' issue.
Integer overflow in destroyTokens function allows the owner to burn arbitrary amount of tokens, reducing total supply arbitrarily, aka 'burnOverflow' issue.
The fallback function allows attackers to acquire large amounts of tokens by sending more than 1 ether, aka 'etherRedirect' issue.
